Each request also runs unchanged.

notes: Run on claude/trinket-enchant-coverage: the coordinator branch at 0705079 with claude/mage-broadening (48d46af) merged, which exports shared.NewSimpleStatActive on-use trinkets as temporary stats.

Fixed here: the exporter's on-use mana fallback compared spelldata's ProcEnergizeEffect with nil rather than NilEffect, whose Misc reads as mana, so every major cooldown item no case described was exported as a mana gain of nothing and accepted. The first run mismatched 150 trinket variants that way (Talisman of Ephemeral Power, Linken's Boomerang and twelve others); each is now described or reported unrepresented.

Added here: Fiery Weapon (803) and Lifestealing (1898), weapon procs at their proc manager's chance per spell that cast the row's damage spell at once; Orb of Fire (12805) through the spell data damage proc; inert listeners for Essence of the Pure Flame, The Lion Horn of Stormwind, Uther's Strength and the three chest Absorption enchants, which hear only melee hits the player takes, so a tank's stay rejected. All 68 weapon enchant, 58 Orb of Fire and the 207 non-tank listener variants match Go.

Mismatches routed: the Threat and Subtlety enchants on feral and bear Druids (the form reset sets the threat multiplier without the permanent enchant aura's factor; shadow-priest agent), and Blood Craze on the two Protection Warrior builds with stat trinkets (fixed maximum health, fixed on claude/max-health-survival 3f4ce62, and the fixed healing power its log prints; fury-warrior agent and the coordinator).

Every trinket variant rejects or matches in both slots alike; the counts per item are its variants over the classes that may wear it (58 for every class, 44 for mana users). What remains most often: on-use items the exporter does not describe (area damage of Smokey's Lighter and Everlook Pathcarver, Infernal Lasso's dot, Linken's Boomerang's travelling physical hit, the survival absorbs and heal, the periodic mana of Mindtap Talisman and Earthen Sigil, Second Wind, Burst of Knowledge); stat trinkets changing resistances, Spirit or school damage, which the runtime holds fixed; spell-hit stat procs (Draconic Infused Emblem, Grand Sorcerer, Grand Arcanist, Insight); Heart of Wyrmthalak's rolled damage proc; Recovery's heal on avoided attacks; Fiery Blaze's area hit.
